title: Reduced Payment Plan Points by Personal Loan Grade
content:
For a Reduced Payment Plan of the Hardship Assistance Programs, a loan in Personal Loan Grade E, F or G earns 3 points; a loan in Personal Loan Grade C or D earns 1 point; a loan in Personal Loan Grade A or B earns none. The grade is the rate grade of the loan on the borrower's Personal Loans record. Each point is one percentage point off the percentage at which the Reduced Payment Plan installment is set.

| Personal Loans grade of the loan | Points |
|---|---|
| Personal Loan Grade E | 3 |
| Personal Loan Grade F | 3 |
| Personal Loan Grade G | 3 |
| Personal Loan Grade C | 1 |
| Personal Loan Grade D | 1 |
| Personal Loan Grade A | none |
| Personal Loan Grade B | none |

The seven grades are the whole range of Personal Loans grades, so every loan falls on exactly one row.
